subject: Post-demo: questionnaire intake, decision owner identification, and systems boundary
summary: Post-demo follow-up to capture the security questionnaire intake, identify the economic/decision owner, and align on systems in scope. Agreed to a security kickoff and procurement next steps; Acme provided a partial questionnaire and procurement contact. Internal asks: SOC 2, data flow diagram, retention policy, and a short kickoff window next week.

Subject: Post-demo: questionnaire intake, decision owner identification, and systems boundary

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same frame: 

Call summary:
- Attendees: Samantha Lee (Acme), Derek Owens (Acme), Karthik Iyer (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Use case: customer support automation + internal summarization for compliance audit logs
- Primary concerns called out: data residency, access controls for KV cache, and audit logs retention

What we need from Acme to kickoff security intake and procurement: 
1) Who is the economic/decision owner for this pilot (name, role, and email) — this determines procurement signoff and SLA expectations.
2) Completed security questionnaire (we've attached a short intake workbook to speed this up) — fields in particular: hosting model (VPC vs hosted), expected throughput, PII categories.
3) Systems in scope: please confirm which components will talk to Redwood (frontend web app, backend API, analytics pipeline, batch ETL, third-party integrations).

Proposed dates: security kickoff call next week — available windows (PST): Tue 8/3 09:00–11:00 or Wed 8/4 13:00–15:00. Please confirm preferred slot.

Attachments: redwood_initial_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (short intake workbook)

Next steps (owner):
- Samantha: confirm economic owner + return partial questionnaire (by EOD Thu 7/30 if possible)
- Redwood (Marissa): assemble SOC2 + retention policy docs to share at kickoff
- Redwood (Karthik): schedule kickoff and share agenda

Thanks — putting this thread in the Acme deal record as well.

Best,
Karthik
